caption: The drawing consists of a centered composition on an off-white background bordered by a thin brown line. Inside the border, there is a wreath-like arrangement made up of two symmetrical green leafy branches curving upward, forming a partial circle. Each branch features several large green leaves, some adorned with small white spots, and is topped with three red, bulbous fruits with similar white spots. At the base of the branches, where they nearly meet, there is a red, flower-like shape with a blue, geometric pattern at its center and a white outline within the blue area. In the open space at the top center of the wreath, there is black, handwritten text that reads “Another.” The artwork uses a palette dominated by green, red, blue, and white, with the main illustration set against a blank, light-colored area within the bordered square.
title: Autograph Quilt
